notes.subject: חרצבות
notes.rationale: daɲɛ in tɛ Tanaki kɔnɔ yɔrɔ wɛrɛ si la

notes.subject: sonu-jɔyɔrɔw
notes.rationale: חרצבות: kɔrɔ tilennen ye kangayɔrɔ ye ('bands' — KJV) nka sɛbɛnnibaga caman b'a kalan ka kɛ sonuyɔrɔ ye ('pangs' — ASV/JPS)

notes.subject: אולם
notes.rationale: daɲɛ in kɔrɔ bɛ se kɛ farisogo ye ('body' — JPS) walima seye ye ('strength' — KJV); Heburukan ka gɛlɛyali bɛ yen sababu daɲɛ in mɔgɔw teerɛ

translation: Sabu, u ka saya kɔnɔ, sonu-jɔyɔrɔw si tɛ ⟨yen⟩; u ka farisogo bɛ jɛ ka gigi.
